query: SELECT r.id FROM scan_runs r WHERE r.state IN ('completed','failed','cancelled') AND r.created_at < now() - make_interval(days => $1) AND (r.provider_id IS NULL OR ( SELECT count(*) FROM ( SELECT 1 FROM scan_runs n WHERE n.provider_id = r.provider_id AND n.mode = r.mode AND n.state IN ('completed','failed') AND n.created_at > r.created_at LIMIT $3 ) newer) >= $3) ORDER BY r.created_at ASC LIMIT $2
